description: This file defines the IndexViewModel class used in the Web.ViewModels.Manage namespace, representing data for managing user account settings such as email, phone number, and confirmation status in an ASP.NET application.

classes.name: IndexViewModel
classes.description: A view model that encapsulates user account information including username, email, phone number, email confirmation status, and a status message.

methods.name: getters and setters for properties
methods.description: Automatically generated property accessors for user data fields such as Username, Email, PhoneNumber, and StatusMessage, along with a boolean IsEmailConfirmed.
